verdict.rationale: Meltano's docs and GitHub repo tout a catalog of 600+ built-in connectors spanning SaaS APIs, databases, and files (meltano-docs-5, meltano-docs-41, meltano-gh-1), and the getting-started guide walks through adding real extractors (e.g. tap-github) via `meltano add` (meltano-docs-3, meltano-docs-24). Community feedback corroborates that core Singer-tap-based connectors (e.g. Postgres) work well, though it also flags that connector quality/support varies since it's open-source with 'no support to pay for' and raises open questions about handling non-mainstream formats like EDIFACT/FHIR (meltano-comm-1, meltano-comm-2, meltano-comm-3). Missing for 10: independent audit of the actual maintenance status/freshness of the 600+ connectors, and confirmation of coverage for less common enterprise data formats.
